newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BLAST IN YUGOSLAV CONSULATE IN SOFIA, NO VICTIMS.
newsitem.headline: BLAST IN YUGOSLAV CONSULATE IN SOFIA, NO VICTIMS.

text.p: A hand-grenade exploded in the yard of the Yugoslav consulate in Sofia early on Wednesday, no victims or serious damages were reported, police said in a statement.
"Around 0200 (0000 GMT) an assault hand-grenade was thrown and exploded in the yard of the consulate of the Yugoslav Republic," the statement said.
The police enforced security around the building and launched an investigation.
Wednesday marked the 36th straight day of protests by thousands of opponents of Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic in neighbouring Belgrade to demand recognition of local election results.
On Tuesday Belgrade was abound with street battles when surging pro- and anti-Milosevic crowds clashed and police waded in to separate the factions.
Bulgaria and Serbia share a 250 mile border.
